falseSynonyms.zh: 利潤不等於一般好處 profit 主要是財務收益；advantage / benefit 可包括時間、便利、效率、能力等非金錢好處。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Lower costs may be an advantage, while profit is the financial gain a business makes.

falseSynonyms.zh: 機會不等於優點 opportunity 是可以做某事的機會；advantage 是某事本身帶來的有利條件或好處。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A scholarship is an opportunity; lower tuition fees are an advantage.

falseSynonyms.zh: 成功結果不等於優勢 success 是達成目標的結果；advantage 是幫助產生較好結果的有利因素。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Good preparation can be an advantage that contributes to success.

falseSynonyms.zh: 特點不一定是優點 feature 只是特徵，可以是正面、中性或負面；advantage 一定帶正面價值。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A feature is simply a characteristic; an advantage is a favourable characteristic.

falseSynonyms.zh: 差異不等於優勢 difference 只表示不同；只有當這種不同帶來好處時才可稱為 advantage。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A difference becomes an advantage only when it is beneficial.

falseSynonyms.zh: 便利只是某一類好處 convenience 可以是 advantage 的一種，但不是所有 advantage 都和便利有關。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Convenience may be one advantage, but lower cost or better quality may be advantages too.
